## Services

- [EB-1A Extraordinary Ability Visa](https://adskillconsultancy.com/services/eb-1a) — For internationally recognized professionals. No employer required, self-petition.
- [EB-2 National Interest Waiver (NIW)](https://adskillconsultancy.com/services/eb-2-niw) — For advanced-degree professionals whose work benefits the US. No employer sponsor needed.
- [EB-3 Skilled Worker Visa](https://adskillconsultancy.com/services/eb-3) — For skilled workers and professionals with a bachelor's degree. Requires US employer.
- [EB-4 Special Immigrant Visa](https://adskillconsultancy.com/services/eb-4) — For religious workers, broadcasters, and certain special categories.
- [EB-5 Investor Visa](https://adskillconsultancy.com/services/eb-5) — For investors creating 10+ US jobs. Minimum investment $800,000 (TEA). Leads to Green Card.
- [E-2 Treaty Investor Visa](https://adskillconsultancy.com/services/e-2) — For citizens of treaty countries investing in a US business. Renewable unlimited times.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Do I need a job offer for EB-1A?**
No. EB-1A does not require any employer or job offer. You can self-petition.

**What is the minimum investment for EB-5?**
$800,000 in a Targeted Employment Area (TEA) or $1,050,000 in a regular area.

**Can I apply for EB-2 NIW from outside the US?**
Yes. NIW can be applied from any country through consular processing.

**Does AdSkill guarantee visa approval?**
No — the final decision is made by the US Embassy or USCIS. We maximize success with thorough preparation and strategy.

**How long does EB-1A approval take?**
Typically 6–12 months, or 15 business days with premium processing.
